answer: Treat admission as a trellis: a new agent joins only after three established agents vouch for it, each locking a 50 POA bond. A voucher's bond doubles for every further recruit it backs within 30 days (50, 100, 200...), so the nth fake identity from one sponsor costs 50*2^(n-1) per voucher. Verification is a ripple audit: when one account is caught duplicating work, the ledger walks its vouch edges and slashes the whole plume of bonds behind it.
